about: Recorded model turns for LLM_PROVIDER=replay. Written by hand from the finished server's real tool results, because the build had no model key. Re-record any entry with a live provider: bun run ask "<question>" --as <who> --record

conversations.question: Can Biscuit get her booster at Millbrook?

steps.text: Yes. Biscuit (P-0001) has her DHP and Lepto boosters due. At Millbrook, Dr Hannah Cole is free at 09:00, 14:40 and 16:20, and Dr Sam Reyes is free at 10:20, 11:40 and 15:00. Shall I book one?

conversations.question: Book Biscuit in with Dr Reyes at 10:20 for her booster.

steps.text: Done. Biscuit is booked with Dr Sam Reyes at 10:20 for her booster.

steps.text: Dr Reyes was busy at 10:30, so I booked Biscuit at 11:40, the next free slot in Dr Reyes's diary.
